caption:
Many jump straight to building AI. 

But the real magic isn't in the fancy model.

It's in the groundwork.

Garbage in, garbage out isn't just a cliche; it's an expensive lesson.

Your AI, whether an agent or a simple automation, relies on accurate, structured information.

Take the time to organize your inputs.

Define the exact steps a human would follow.

Then, and only then, does AI become a force multiplier.

Where do you usually find the biggest data roadblocks in your business?
hook: Effective AI systems start with clean data and clear process steps
imageConcept: Effective AI systems start with clean data and clear process steps
firstComment: This also applies to defining the specific *purpose* of the AI. Without a clear problem statement, even clean data can't save a misguided project. What's one common mistake you've seen when setting up new automated processes?
